title: Kashmiri Pandits flag graveyard en route to Shankaracharya Hill, says ‘cropped up suddenly’
description: The J&K administration’s Roads and Buildings (R&B) department, in an order on September 12 this year, had approved ₹44.37 lakhs for “improvement of Astan Aliya Syed Usman Sahib on the way to Shankaracharya road”
